text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Visiting the studio for a photoshoot meeting for my trainee Uma Musume, I saw Daiwa Scarlet talking with a photographer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I see...! So there's also a style where you just take commemorative photos.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: Photo weddings are really popular because of how much freedom you have with both costumes and locations. The best part is capturing wedding photos that truly feel like 'you'.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: Ah, here's a brochure for a wedding hall I work with often. If you're interested, why not go take a tour?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you, I'll definitely check it out for reference!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: This venue is hosting a bridal fair. But usually, these are things couples go see together, right...
choice_data_list: Is that a wedding hall brochure?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Actually, I was invited to a fan's wedding ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And apparently, they tied the knot because cheering for me brought them together! That's why, if I'm attending, I feel like I need to understand it much deeper!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ............Do you remember that party before? When Sensei's dress got stained—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —I tried to convince Sensei that the stain wasn't noticeable and that we didn't have time. But...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Today has become the most radiant, brightest day of my entire life. Thank you from the bottom of my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —I was so disgusted with myself... Even though I thought I understood more than anyone what it feels like to want to shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's why I swore to myself. For this upcoming wedding, I will truly connect with and support the bride's feelings!
choice_data_list: So that's why you want to understand weddings better.
So you want to understand weddings better for their sake.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes. But, I do have one dilemma...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm thinking about visiting the bridal fair right now. But I'm wondering if it's really okay for me to go alone...
choice_data_list: I'll come with you to the tour.
I'll come with you to the tour.
How about going with a friend?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm thinking about visiting the bridal fair right now. But I'm wondering if it's really okay for me to go alone...
choice_data_list: I'll come with you to the tour.
I'll come with you to the tour.
How about going with a friend?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't be unusual for an Uma Musume active in show business to be invited to perform at a wedding. If we explain it's for future reference, the venue surely won't mind.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even though you came along just to keep me company, I'm making you carry all the pamphlets and stuff. I'm sorry.
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it, let's keep looking around.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So this is the chapel...! Waaaah~~! It's so romantic!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you very much. Bringing our guests' happiest moments to life here is our greatest joy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Bringing happy moments to life... What a wonderful job!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If it's not too much trouble, could I hear a little more about your work?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet listened earnestly as the staff shared their passion for weddings. Attending the fair proved to be deeply fruitful for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told Daiwa Scarlet that venues are always glad to welcome even one more potential future customer, so going with a friend would be totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I see! In that case, I'll go look for a friend to take with me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —So, why the hell'd it have to be me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-It's not like I had a choice! You were the only one who was totally free today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Besides, you might get invited to a fan's wedding someday too, right? Doing some prep now won't hurt, will it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well... If I got invited and totally blew it, that wouldn't look cool at all. Guess we might as well check out every corner of this place today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, a surprise entrance on a motorcycle?! Wouldn't pulling something like that totally hype the place up?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: There you go again... But still, that definitely leaves an impression. Can you even ride one in a wedding dress, though?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two toured the venue, bouncing ideas back and forth. Daiwa Scarlet deepened her understanding of weddings step by step.
